premises.text: Depression patients face stigma, distrust of care, long waits, and months of antidepressant trial-and-error
premises.evidence_span: why don't patients get treatment for depression? One reason is the social stigma that exists around it

premises.text: Existing DNA, mRNA, and protein approaches fail as practical predictive biomarkers for depression care
premises.evidence_span: there are no good biomarkers that exist today

premises.text: Circular RNA in blood is a stable, predictive biomarker for diagnosing depression and predicting medication response
premises.evidence_span: use a new biomarker called circular RNA to help diagnose, monitor treatment, and monitor treatment of mental health conditions

premises.text: A lab pipeline extracts blood RNA and runs circRNA-specific qPCR with analytics to profile diagnosis and drug response
premises.evidence_span: we use a process called quantitative, circRNA-specific quantitative PCR

premises.text: Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care are the channels that need faster depression diagnosis workflows
premises.evidence_span: There are three channels that we see our product easily going into the market. Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care
